title: 第21章 朗姆村更多的怪物第22章 危机解除发现奇怪的小青菜
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
下午一点。
菲尔德率领奴隶卫兵进入灰雾之中，其实，身处灰雾之中很难产生时间的概念，因为一直都灰蒙蒙的，只有晚上，才会变成伸手不见五指的黑暗。阿诗娜骑着巨狼，在队伍的最前方负责开路，神选者的眼睛似乎经过改造，能更清晰地观测这个世界。
随后就是菲尔德和他新组建的奴隶卫队，保持着较慢的速度，在满是荆棘和血肉触手的树林，艰难前进。
“按照地图显示，我们很快就能抵达朗姆村，曾经为城市提供丰富蔬菜的村庄。”
“可惜我现在只能看到腐化。”阿诗娜将手搭在眼睛上方，竭力远眺，“唔，当心我们的右前方，有七只腐尸靠拢过来了，我想他们就是朗姆村的村民。”
“给新人练练手。”
见阿诗娜一脸轻松，菲尔德知道来的腐尸都是小垃圾，正好让新兵见见血。
几个新兵听了，齐刷刷发出吞咽口水的咕咚声，本能告诉他们，这时候应该逃跑了，但领主大人就在身后，他们可不敢妄动。
想到爽滑可口的鸡蛋，卫兵们仿佛灵魂都得到了升华，大许多奴隶活到现在，都没吃上过鸡蛋。中午吃鸡蛋的时候，不少人连咀嚼都来不及，急吼吼地将鸡蛋吞进肚子，好几个人都被鸡蛋卡住。但饶是如此，他们都感受到了快乐。
为了享受这份快乐，就算冒着死亡的风险，奴隶们也乐意承受。
“吼~”
灰雾中冲出一个类似楼兰古尸的女人，没有一件衣服，干瘪恶心的胸脯耷拉到了小腹，浑身上下充斥着粘液。
老练的奴隶卫兵立起长戟，从各个方向刺出，将腐尸牢牢架住。
“来，戳爆她的脑袋，或是往胸腔多刺几下，手要稳，身体的摆动幅度不能太大。”
山猫很大方地分享经验，然后拽着新兵，将腿脚酥软的家伙拖到腐尸面前。
新兵举了几次长戟，愣是不敢刺，甚至被嘶吼的腐尸吓得尿了裤子。
“这是魔魔鬼。”有新兵牙齿打颤。
菲尔德前世看过不少丧尸片，但奴隶们并没有，他们认为腐尸身上居住着魔鬼，一个不小心，就会被魔鬼诅咒。
“动手！别像个懦弱的鹌鹑。”菲尔德喝骂一声，不能让士兵们产生恐惧情绪，因为恐惧会传染，到时候更多人会将腐尸看做魔鬼，而不是一只能杀死的生物，“就算是魔鬼，有我，以及神选者在这里，你怕个毛！魔鬼也照样杀给你看！”
“噗嗤~”

被菲尔德一顿骂，士兵总算递出了长戟，虽然是闭着眼的，甚至差点刺歪扑进腐尸的怀抱，但总算走出了第一步。
新兵做完这一切后，双腿一软，瘫倒在地。
“看，并不困难，也没有诅咒。”菲尔德指指地上的尸体，轻快地打了个响指，“只要把握好距离，他们比傻狍子还好对付。”
其他的腐尸围拢而来，有了第一人示范，其余新兵也鼓起勇气展开攻击。
轻松解决掉这批怪物后，菲尔德带着众人继续前进，很快抵达了朗姆村外。
“这些腐尸怎么回事？”
菲尔德看着小地图上，不断颤抖的骷髅头标志，困惑地挠挠头。
content_en:
One o'clock in the afternoon.
Field led the slave guards into the gray fog. In fact, it is difficult to have the concept of time in the gray fog, because it is always gray, and only at night will it turn into darkness that makes you unable to see your fingers. Ashina rides a giant wolf and is responsible for clearing the way at the front of the team. The Chosen One's eyes seem to have been modified to observe the world more clearly.
Then came Field and his newly formed slave guards, maintaining a slower pace and struggling to advance through the woods full of thorns and fleshy tentacles.
"Following the map, we will soon arrive at Rum Village, a village that once provided abundant vegetables to the city."
"It's a pity that I can only see corruption now." Ashina put her hands above her eyes and tried her best to look far away. "Well, be careful in front of us to the right. There are seven rotting corpses approaching. I think they are the villagers of Rum Village."
"Give the newcomers some practice time."
Seeing Ashina's relaxed face, Field knew that the corpses that came were just small garbage, just in time for the new recruits to see blood.
After hearing this, several recruits made a gulping sound in unison. Their instincts told them that they should run away at this time, but the Lord was behind them and they did not dare to act rashly.
Thinking of the smooth and delicious eggs, the guards seemed to have their souls sublimated. Most slaves have never eaten eggs until now. When eating eggs for lunch, many people swallowed the eggs quickly without even having time to chew them. Several people got stuck in the eggs. But even so, they all felt happy.
In order to enjoy this happiness, slaves are willing to bear the risk of death.
"Roar~"
A woman who looked like Loulan's ancient corpse rushed out of the gray mist. She had no clothes, her withered and disgusting breasts drooped to her lower abdomen, and her whole body was filled with mucus.
The experienced slave guards raised their halberds and thrust them out from all directions to hold the corpse firmly.
"Come on, poke her head or stab her chest a few more times. Your hands should be steady and your body should not swing too much."
The lynx shared his experience generously, and then dragged the new recruit, dragging the guy with weak legs and feet to the carrion.
The recruit raised his halberd several times but did not dare to stab it. He was even frightened by the roaring carrion and even wet his pants.
"This is a devil." A recruit's teeth chattered.
Field had seen a lot of zombie movies in his previous life, but the slaves had not. They believed that the devil lived in the corpses, and if they were not careful, they would be cursed by the devil.
"Do it! Don't be like a cowardly quail." Field yelled, not letting the soldiers feel fear, because fear will be contagious, and more people will see the carrion as a devil instead of a creature that can be killed. "Even if it is a devil, with me and the Chosen One here, you are afraid of nothing! The devil will still kill you!"
"Pfft~"
After being scolded by Field, the soldier finally handed over the halberd. Although his eyes were closed, and he almost thrust into the arms of the corpse, he finally took the first step.
After the recruit finished all this, his legs weakened and he collapsed to the ground.
"Look, it's not difficult, and there's no curse." Field pointed to the corpse on the ground and snapped his fingers briskly, "As long as you control the distance, they are easier to deal with than the stupid roe deer."
Other wights gathered around, and with the first person demonstrating, the rest of the recruits plucked up the courage to attack.
After easily dealing with these monsters, Field led everyone to move forward and soon arrived outside Rum Village.
"What's going on with these wights?"
Field looked at the trembling skull symbol on the mini-map and scratched his head in confusion.
